entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Founder of the Markov bloodline and first vampire of Innistrad, over 7000 years old.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Edgar's grandson, a planeswalker whose spark ignited when Edgar turned him.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: Demon who convinced Edgar to experiment with blood.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire who stole Edgar's coffin and proposed to him.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Spirit who manifested from the Key.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Attacked by Edgar in the ballroom.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker who found Olivia and Edgar with her pack.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Site of Edgar's mausoleum and the ruined wedding.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: City where Edgar hid in taverns.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi in the Moon, causing the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Echoverse Edgar Markov
entities.description: Alternate version made a werewolf by Shilgengar, locked in the Helvault by Sorin.

events.summary: Shilgengar convinces Edgar to experiment with blood; Edgar traps and drains the angel Marycz, creating the first vampires.
events.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

events.summary: Edgar forces Sorin to turn and Sorin's spark ignites.
events.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused Sorin 's planeswalker spark to ignite

events.summary: Olivia steals Edgar's coffin, wakes him and proposes; he agrees.
events.quote: The confused Edgar agreed to her marriage proposal.

events.summary: Sorin attacks Olivia during the vows and Sigarda is freed, shattering the glass.
events.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

events.summary: Edgar and Sorin fight in the sanguitorium.
events.quote: the two came to blows as they hurled insults

events.summary: Empowered Sorin overpowers Edgar and shows mercy, ordering him to leave.
events.quote: Sorin showed mercy and ordered his grandfather to leave.

events.summary: Arlinn and her pack find Olivia and Edgar, who escape through a broken window.
events.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar

events.summary: Olivia leaves for Thunder Junction and Edgar hides in Havengul awaiting his chance.
events.quote: awaiting his next chance to return to power

relations.quote: when he forced his grandson to turn

relations.note: convinced him to experiment with blood
relations.quote: the demon Shilgengar convinced Edgar to start experiments with blood
